title: Canvas Learning System Public Annotation Source Manifest v2 Draft

manifest_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256(CLS/A01-MANIFEST/v2\0 || JCS(NFC-normalized public manifest projection UTF-8 bytes)). The written \0 denotes one NUL byte. The frozen excluded-field list is exactly: root manifest_payload_sha256 and the entire root invariant_check object. parent_manifest_payload_sha256 and every other field remain in scope. The independent checker recomputes this payload; a self-asserted digest is never an acceptance gate.

hash_profile_id.description: Frozen contract profile. Private commitments serialize as hmac-sha256:CLS_PRIVATE_CONTENT_v2:<hex> or hmac-sha256:CLS_APPROVAL_RECEIPT_v2:<hex>, mapping exactly to domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2\0 and CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2\0 respectively. Field-specific HMAC domains are forbidden.

source_object_inventory.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by source_object_id then object_revision ascending. The checker rejects duplicate business IDs and duplicate content identities even when whole objects differ.

source_binding_inventory.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by binding_id ascending. Multiple distinct bindings may reference one SourceObject as provenance aliases; duplicate binding IDs or semantic locator aliases are rejected by the checker.

scan_attempt_inventory.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by scan_attempt_id ascending. Attempts are append-only evidence; current SourceObject state points to an exact attempt and object revision.

publicContentIdentity.description: Public-only identity serialized as sha256:<hex>, computed as SHA-256(CLS/A01-SOURCE-OBJECT/v2\0 || original source bytes). The checker forbids it whenever any current binding places the object above P1 or outside the adjudicated public HEAD boundary.

privateContentCommitment.description: Serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC-SHA256 domain bytes CLS/PRIVATE-CONTENT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

approvalReceiptCommitment.description: Trusted receipt commitment; serialized tag maps exactly to HMAC-SHA256 domain bytes CLS/APPROVAL-RECEIPT/v2 followed by one NUL byte.

timestamp.description: Strict UTC Z lexical form. The invariant checker must additionally reject impossible calendar dates and prove cutoff/attempt/approval/check timestamps are monotonic.

rootId.description: Physical authorization roots only. Archive-derived is a SourceBinding classification overlay, not a root and never an authorization grant. Repository archives inherit ROOT-REPO-CURRENT or ROOT-GIT-REFS; an external archive requires its own separately approved physical root.

bindingRootId.description: Physical authorization roots allowed on SourceBinding. The archive-derived token belongs only in classification_overlays, never in root_id and never grants authorization.

report_payload_sha256.description: Bare SHA-256 is allowed only for a reviewed public canonical scan report containing no private locator, source bytes, error text, or secret material.

head_commit_oid.description: High-entropy identity of the adjudicated public committed HEAD plane only; it conveys no authorization to expose refs, index, dirty worktree, or private roots.

head_tree_oid.description: High-entropy identity of the adjudicated public committed HEAD tree only.

refs_inventory_commitment.description: Git refs/history is P2. Its inventory may enter the public projection only as a CLS_PRIVATE_CONTENT_v2 keyed commitment; no bare digest is allowed.

sourceRootSet.description: Exactly eight physical authorization roots, stably sorted by the rootId enum ordinal declared in this schema version. Archive-derived is intentionally absent because it is only a SourceBinding classification overlay. Repository archives inherit ROOT-REPO-CURRENT or ROOT-GIT-REFS; external archives require a separately approved physical root.

sourcePlaneSet.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by the planeId enum ordinal declared in this schema version.

exclude_by_default.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by reason code in Unicode code-point order.

scan_then_classify.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by reason code in Unicode code-point order.

object_revision.description: Append-only SourceObject revision. ScanAttempt.object_revision and trusted exclusion receipts bind this exact value.

classification_overlays.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by enum token. Archive-derived is an overlay on the physical root/plane binding and never creates a duplicate occurrence.

approved_object_total.description: Checker-proven denominator: scanned + excluded + unreadable + parse_error + source_unavailable + pending over exactly the authorized object ID set.

invariantCheck.description: Mandatory second gate after JSON Schema. The complete command must invoke the frozen checker and independently recompute this report; document-authored state=pass strings are not evidence. The entire invariant_check object is excluded from manifest_payload_sha256, while report_payload_sha256 excludes only itself from the canonical public checker report.

report_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the public canonical checker report after excluding report_payload_sha256 itself. This report is outside manifest hash scope.

failure_codes.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by reason code in Unicode code-point order.

blockers.description: Canonical set array, stably sorted by reason code in Unicode code-point order.
